create_realtime_client_secret: create a realtime client secret endpoint that generates an encrypted ephemeral token for WebRTC sessions
proxy_realtime_calls: proxy realtime WebRTC SDP negotiation calls using encrypted ephemeral tokens from the client
encode_realtime_token_payload: encode a realtime token payload with ephemeral key, model id, user id, team id, and expiry metadata
decode_realtime_token_payload: decode and validate a realtime token payload returning None for legacy or malformed tokens
test_realtime_token_version: test the realtime token version string used to distinguish new payloads from legacy ephemeral keys
